methods.question: hybrid-block-methodology
methods.description: Select explicit joint priorities and baseline-relative exposure envelope; generate a feasible week, retaining commitments and allowing bounded review.
methods.provenance: Original candidate methodology, Research Packet 006 revision 0.1, sections 3–4.
methods.tradeoffs: No validated archetype ranking or duration; method and numerical parameters need separate review.

methods.question: strength-maintenance-dose
methods.description: Retain selected lift-specific practice at tolerable loading and review comparable outcomes before further reductions.
methods.provenance: Original candidate methodology, Research Packet 006 revision 0.1, sections 3–4.
methods.tradeoffs: Evidence from different populations; no guaranteed floor; preserve low existing dose when appropriate.

methods.question: endurance-maintenance-dose
methods.description: Protect agreed running outcomes with habitual-relative specific exposure; assess retention separately from completion.
methods.provenance: Original candidate methodology, Research Packet 006 revision 0.1, sections 3–4.
methods.tradeoffs: Capacity does not establish running performance; duration and intensity tradeoffs uncertain.

methods.question: strength-deload-intervention
methods.description: Choose hold, local change or coordinated stress reduction according to purpose, feedback, constraints and outcomes.
methods.provenance: Original candidate methodology, Research Packet 006 revision 0.1, sections 3–4.
methods.tradeoffs: No evidence-based universal timing or reduction; clinical concerns require appropriate referral.

methods.question: endurance-taper-performance
methods.description: Protect priority event by shaping both modalities and preserving appropriate specific exposure; compare feasible calendars.
methods.provenance: Original candidate methodology, Research Packet 006 revision 0.1, sections 3–4.
methods.tradeoffs: Single-discipline evidence does not establish optimal joint taper; no automatic overload or cutoff.

methods.question: hybrid-block-methodology
methods.description: Review comparable outcomes, actual exposure, burden and objectives; retain productive work, propose bounded change or explicit block revision.
methods.provenance: Original candidate methodology, Research Packet 006 revision 0.1, sections 3–4.
methods.tradeoffs: No causal individual model; missingness and alternative explanations matter; athlete approval required.
